entries.en:
This footage captures an Abraham standing by inside a warehouse.
Many security companies own multiple Labors like this.
There are problems, however.
A major security company has ample funds to own many of the latest Labors.
Medium-sized and smaller companies are not so fortunate.
At one regional security company I visited, there was only a single, very old Labor.
Frankly, it had not been maintained well and seemed little more than a display.
(With hardly any civilian Labors in that region, perhaps there is less need.)

Wouldn't life become safer and more secure if the hundreds of billions of yen the government wastes every year were used to lend Labors regularly to security companies throughout the country?

entries.en:
After the giant-shadow incident that struck Miyato City today, many residents are spending an anxious night in shelters.
Among them, street performer Watanabe is reportedly easing the atmosphere with simple magic tricks and pantomime.
'At first, I stayed quiet, thinking people might get angry at me for performing during an emergency. But when I showed a little child a magic trick to comfort them, a crowd formed before I knew it...'
Evacuees reportedly thanked the performer, saying it had warmed their hearts.
Watanabe said, 'I'm happy my skills can be useful.'

entries.en:
Gunshots were reported near Suzuran Avenue in Miyato City.
According to witnesses, an intimidating man was threatening two young people with a gun.
The young people later escaped amid the confusion when flying monsters appeared, while the armed man was carried off by a monster.

Police increasingly suspect gang involvement. However, with officers occupied responding to successive anomalies across the area, they may be unable to assign enough personnel to the investigation.

entries.en:
A new bank-transfer scam has recently attracted attention. The perpetrator reportedly calls victims saying things like, 'Grandma, it's me! Let me do something nice for you,' then doubles the money they transfer and gives it back.
The damage does not end there. Other repeated misdeeds reportedly include sending expensive bedding and installing handrails in every room of the house.
Police are said to be searching for the culprit with all their resources.

entries.en:
A beloved sign that had long served as a symbol of Suzuran Avenue was destroyed by Gyaos.
Since it was such a well-known meeting spot, expressions of sadness have continued to pour in.

entries.en:
The famous sign destroyed by Gyaos landed in a spot too cruel to call miraculous.
It fell so as to block the entrance to PANSIE's West Wing.
Yes, the very entrance where people had been seeking refuge moments earlier.
Strong winds were blowing that day. Experts believe they caught the damaged sign and positioned it precisely across the entrance.
The impact cracked the ground and badly deformed the sign itself.
Whether anyone was nearby at the time is unknown. But anyone crushed beneath it would almost certainly have died...
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k130; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Amid the Gyaos incident in Miyato City, numerous traffic accidents made the roads impassable to pedestrians. Some people reportedly climbed onto tanker trucks to get around. E, who lives in an apartment along Suzuran Avenue and witnessed this, said, 'Because they were moving high up, some were spotted and carried off by flying monsters. I couldn't even call out to them. There was nothing I could do...'

entries.en:
Suzuran Avenue is said to have been a vital transportation route since long ago, when settlements large enough to call towns were still few.

Apparently, the surrounding area was then enclosed by rugged mountains and supposedly bottomless marshes, making this street the only flat, safe passage.

At some point, development began along the route, and houses went up one after another.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k148; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Documents record that Suzuran Avenue flourished as a post town around six hundred years ago.

The area apparently was unsuitable for farmland, but proved extremely valuable as a stopping point on the way to the next post town.
Entertainment establishments also opened one after another for travelers to enjoy, making it something like a modern entertainment district.

Looking back now, perhaps this was the prototype of Suzuran Avenue.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k150; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
As Western culture began arriving, modernization advanced around Suzuran Avenue.

Wooden houses were rebuilt one after another as Western-style buildings with mortar finishes.
Along with this, the buildings lining the avenue grew ever larger.

Modernization spread quickly through the area, reportedly making it one of the country's foremost cutting-edge towns and attracting still more visitors.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k152; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Even as an ominous sense of approaching war spread nationwide, Suzuran Avenue's entertainment district continued to flourish.
Large bribes apparently allowed it to operate freely without attracting the authorities' disapproval.

Visitors therefore reportedly described it as heaven itself.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k154; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
During the war, even bribes could no longer provide an escape. With luxury branded the enemy, Suzuran Avenue appeared to have fallen into decline.
In fact, although its entertainment establishments were officially closed, business apparently continued behind the scenes.

Naturally, the ordinary customers of earlier days could not visit during wartime. Instead, the establishments reportedly made decent profits serving high-ranking military officials.
The people of Suzuran Avenue seem to have always been resilient.
Unfortunately, however, air raids destroyed most of its buildings.
For the first time, Suzuran Avenue lost its glamour.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k156; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
After the war, the area around Suzuran Avenue recovered at an astonishing speed.
Although the buildings had been lost to air raids, people apparently had moved their accumulated money elsewhere, leaving ample funds for rebuilding.
The streetscape forming the basis of today's district reportedly emerged almost overnight.
Furthermore, this reconstruction apparently marked the adoption of the name Suzuran Avenue.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k158; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Mysterious Characters on Manhole Covers

Nobody knows when it began, but the manhole covers on Suzuran Avenue reportedly bear different characters.
One has 'ろ' (ro), another 'か' (ka), and so on.
Officially, the explanation is that the patterns merely resemble characters. Yet it is strange that supposedly mass-produced covers should all have slightly different patterns.

One theory says that reading them in a particular order forms a code. Decipher it, and you can supposedly find treasure buried by a shop that once stood on Suzuran Avenue.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k160; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The Night the Gas Lamps Flared Together

Back when the streetlights were gas lamps, a strange phenomenon occurred: for some reason, only the lamps on Suzuran Avenue suddenly burned much more fiercely, all at once.
An investigation found no abnormalities, and why it happened only in this area remains a mystery.

However, it happened twice, and both times a major earthquake struck somewhere the following day. Some therefore rumor that a precursor to the earthquake manifested locally.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k162; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
A Mysterious Shadow Wandering Late at Night

Shortly before dawn, when even the entertainment district grows deserted, a shadow is reportedly seen wandering aimlessly.
Anyone who sees it, or someone close to them, is said to die within three days.

Two or three people reportedly see it each year, and deaths among them or their close relatives have indeed been reported.
However, if you see the shadow and deliberately bump into it, the misfortune can supposedly be avoided.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k164; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
A Car with No Driver

You may not pay much attention while walking around town, but witnesses sometimes report driverless cars passing along Suzuran Avenue.
Of course, these are not the self-driving vehicles currently under development.
They are clearly old passenger cars, with slightly tinted windows.

Seeing one the day before an exam or business negotiation is said to bring success.
Perhaps, being a car, it helps things move along nicely.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k166; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Streetlights Going Out Together

About five years ago, the streetlights on Suzuran Avenue alone all went out at once.
It was not a localized power outage, and the cause remains unknown.

But when a major earthquake struck elsewhere the following day, locals reportedly recalled the past.
Something similar had happened back in the days of gas lamps.

Locals say, 'The next time all the streetlights go out together, there will definitely be a major earthquake somewhere the following day.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k168; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
A Voice Calling from Behind

Many people walking along Suzuran Avenue report suddenly being called by a child's voice from behind, only to turn around and find no child there.

Moreover, if the voice is a boy's, misfortune supposedly follows; if it is a girl's, happiness follows.
It is a fifty-fifty gamble, but apparently quite a few young people hoping for success in love deliberately walk the avenue repeatedly, ready to take their chances.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k170; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Solve It and Die: The Seventh Mystery

The seventh of Suzuran Avenue's Seven Mysteries is, in fact, unknown.
Perhaps there is a clue somewhere that could reveal it. Perhaps there is not.

However, anyone who learns the seventh mystery is said to die at that very moment.
Several people who investigated it in the past have indeed died. Neither preexisting illness nor an accident was responsible: they died suddenly.
People want to investigate everything, but perhaps this teaches us that some things are better left unknown.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0013.json:p0/k172; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
At around 3 a.m. today, a gigantic, mysterious red life-form appeared in Sumire Ward, Miyato City. It cut through nearby buildings one after another, causing extensive damage.
Its identity and purpose remain completely unknown.
The government also announced that, like the mysterious black life-form that appeared on Nanohana Street today, this red creature will be called an 'Angel.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k76; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: ＜Photo＞ Giants in Battle
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k79; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
A giant humanoid weapon faces the red Angel that appeared near radio station RSG in Sumire Ward around 3 a.m. today.
It emerged from launch equipment built into the road.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k80; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Dangerous incidents in parks late at night have become frequent in Sumire Ward, Miyato City, since the start of the year. Police have increased nighttime patrol staffing and taken other measures, but so far there appears to be little noticeable effect. The Sumire police chief said, 'We intend to implement various measures to protect residents' safety.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k82; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
'Isn't road construction supposed to happen at the end of the fiscal year?'
A, a Sumire Ward resident in Miyato City, is increasingly frustrated by roadworks continuing into the new fiscal year. As of this week, thirty-six roadwork sites are operating in the ward, drawing numerous complaints from residents unable to go about their normal lives.
A said, 'I'm appalled by the lack of planning in Sumire Ward, which commissions the work.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k84; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Sumire Ward Mystery Building Identified as Humanoid Weapon Armory
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k87; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Amid today's red Angel incident in Sumire Ward, Miyato City, a building long regarded as a mystery by residents was revealed to be an armory for the giant humanoid weapon.
It stands on the street in front of the radio station in the affected ward. The humanoid weapon reportedly retrieved firearms from inside it to fight the red Angel.
Because nobody ever seemed to be there, residents had called it the 'mystery building.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k88; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Live Show Audience Member May Have Entered Staff Room
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k89; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
We have learned that an intruder entered the staff room of Miyato City's Radio Sky Garden late tonight and took a soft drink.
A live performance of the popular late-night show Midnight Sky Garden was being held there, and an audience member is believed to have entered the room.
The intruder took orange juice from a staff member's desk, with no other losses reported. The staff member sympathized, saying, 'There are no vending machines in the station. Maybe they were thirsty and couldn't help taking my juice,' while expressing dissatisfaction with the station's facilities.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k90; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: ＜Photo＞ Humanoid Weapon Name? Writing on Launch Equipment
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k91; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Writing was confirmed on the launch equipment used by the giant humanoid weapon that repelled the red Angel in Sumire Ward, Miyato City, today.
Could it identify the company that built the equipment, or the equipment itself?
The equipment is built into the road, but neither the national nor local government has announced anything about it or the humanoid weapon.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k92; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Sumire Ward Incident: Travel Agency Manager in Distress
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k93; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k95; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
People who failed to escape the red Angel incident in Sumire Ward, Miyato City.
They watch the battle between the red Angel and the giant humanoid weapon unfold before them.
Eventually, the humanoid weapon repelled the red Angel, and they were able to return home safely.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k96; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: ＜Photo＞ Giant Humanoid Weapon Repels Red Angel
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k97; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The red Angel that appeared in Sumire Ward, Miyato City, sliced through buildings with glowing, whip-like arms, even piercing the giant humanoid weapon's body.
In the end, however, the humanoid weapon repelled it. Intense light enveloped the area at that moment.
When the residents watching realized the humanoid weapon had won, they celebrated with one another.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k98; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Firefighter Rallies After Encouragement from a Colleague
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k99; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Musician Saki Honjo at Red Angel Incident: 'Especially at a Time Like This'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k101; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Musician Saki Honjo was scheduled to perform at today's live broadcast of the late-night radio program Midnight Sky Garden. She was caught in the incident while waiting in the dressing room for her turn.

'I was concentrating while listening to Aya Suzumura, who was performing before me, when the music suddenly stopped. As I wondered what had happened, a dazzling light shot overhead. There was an enormous noise, and I ducked instinctively. When I looked up, the ceiling was gone and I could see the sky.'

Together with fellow performer Aya Suzumura, Honjo encouraged the panicking people, descended the stairs, and escaped the building with her life.

Honjo has a hit song called Kimi No Tonari De and has long encouraged people by performing in disaster-stricken areas. With Miyato City badly damaged by the giant-shadow anomalies, she told us firmly, 'Especially at a time like this, my singing has meaning.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k102; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Musician Aya Suzumura at Red Angel Incident: 'We Will Finish This Concert'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k103; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Musician Aya Suzumura was caught in the incident during a public live broadcast of her radio program Midnight Sky Garden. The red Angel cut away the part of the building immediately above the live studio.

Suzumura had planned to perform Sky for Two of Us and See You. that day, but the incident forced the show to stop. Some fans were reportedly more disappointed at not hearing her songs to the end than at being caught in the incident.
She reportedly promised the evacuated fans that she would perform in Miyato City again.

Suzumura said, 'After talking with the staff, we considered canceling today's show. But I wanted to convey my feelings to the fans who came and the people listening, so we decided to perform. As a result, everyone was put in danger, and I am truly sorry. But I think the desire to hold a concert on a day like this matters deeply. We will finish this concert.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k104; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A Milestone in the Cats' Game Development Request
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k105; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Late tonight, Toro and Kuro, who are developing Absolutely Safe City 2: Good Night, announced that completion was now in sight.
＜主人公＞ played a major role in development. Apparently, the project would have been canceled without this person's efforts to clear various tasks. Toro said, 'Now we have everything we need, meow. It's as good as finished, meow. Leave the rest to us, meow!'

The precise release date remains undecided, but fans of the previous game are already voicing both anticipation and concern.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0010.json:p0/k106; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Just now, an enormous silver machine was carried by transport aircraft to the front of the Fortune Center Building in Yotsuba Ward.
No announcement has yet been made, but it is thought to be the new Self-Defense Force weapon mentioned in witness reports.

Immediately after landing, it began attacking the giant creature. A ray fired from what appeared to be its mouth caused the creature to recoil noticeably.

The giant weapon appears to be an effective countermeasure. However, its appearance and attacks share many features with the giant creature, suggesting some connection between them.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k160; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Just now, the enormous silver weapon suddenly stopped moving.
The reason is uncertain, but it appears to have lost power.
Perhaps this was unexpected: the transport aircraft seem to be watching from a distance.

Meanwhile, the giant creature left the Yotsuba Ward area and disappeared.
Witnesses say it submerged in the nearby sea.

The events were startlingly sudden, but the area around Yotsuba Ward has gone from devastation back to an eerie quiet.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k162; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Numerous witness reports have arrived concerning the giant weapon's shutdown.
Their common element is that 'the giant weapon seemed to stop suddenly after the enormous black creature let out a mighty roar.'
With insufficient information about the weapon, we cannot be certain, but some connection between it and the giant creature remains possible.
If the reports of a roar stopping it are true, however, wouldn't that be a fatal weakness in a countermeasure against the creature?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k164; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Just now, the enormous silver weapon that had stopped moving suddenly started up and began destroying the city.

One transport aircraft watching nearby approached, perhaps to guide it, but was shot down by a missile it fired.
The remaining two aircraft apparently immediately headed toward the crash site.

Judging by the situation, the giant weapon appears to be out of control.
Walking while destroying the city, it looks just like that enormous black creature.

It is now heading straight for the Fortune Center Building. If it maintains this course, a head-on collision with the building will be unavoidable.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k166; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The enormous silver weapon finally stopped after rampaging for as long as thirty minutes.
It was subsequently recovered by transport aircraft.

The situation appears to be over, but the weapon's rampage has left deep scars throughout the area.
The Fortune Center Building has been completely destroyed, and homes along its route have suffered devastating damage.
Recovery in Yotsuba Ward looks likely to take considerable time.

The government has yet to make an announcement. An explanation to the public and swift assistance for victims are now needed.
This is the worst human-caused disaster on record. Public condemnation and demands for accountability will be unavoidable.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k168; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The giant weapon, apparently out of control, began moving while firing missiles indiscriminately.

Large numbers of missiles struck nearby facilities, causing immense damage.
The Fortune Center Building in particular came under concentrated fire.

An expert commented, 'I can only think those missiles were aimed at the building. There is no way to check now, but perhaps there was something inside that the giant shadows were after.'

In response, police have apparently decided to question people connected with the Fortune Center Building soon.
Further developments in the investigation are eagerly awaited.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k172; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The biology of the giant creature that appeared this time seems to be attracting scholars' attention worldwide.

The first question concerns its enormous body.
Its appearance suggests a reptile, but how it sustains a body far larger than any creature on Earth remains a mystery.
It presumably needs tremendous energy, yet so far it has not been observed feeding on anything.

The next question concerns the ray it fires from its mouth.
This creature can make its dorsal fins glow and emit an extremely high-energy beam from its mouth.
Rather than a survival mechanism, this is practically a weapon and seems difficult to explain as a product of biological evolution.
Furthermore, it releases energy while already requiring an enormous supply to sustain its size.

One biologist concluded, 'The only explanation is nuclear fusion inside its body.' Most scholars disagree, saying nuclear fusion inside a living creature is impossible.
However, some have expressed a degree of understanding: 'It would make sense if the beam from its mouth were a way of releasing waste heat.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k176; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
We received a sighting from K, a birdwatching enthusiast, which we would like to share.
K was apparently watching the giant creature through a telescope when a glance at the Fortune Center Building revealed someone still inside.

Curious, K zoomed in and saw the person desperately doing something. The next moment, a woman stood up. Presumably, the person had been rescuing her.
K said, 'Well, that surprised me. I wondered what someone was doing in a place like that, and apparently they were helping a woman. I don't think I could ever have done it. Quite admirable, really.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k180; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
We received a strange sighting from K, a birdwatching enthusiast, which we would like to share.
K was apparently watching the giant creature through a telescope when a glance at the Fortune Center Building revealed someone inside.

Curious, K zoomed in and saw, astonishingly, someone smirking in the midst of this dangerous situation.
K said in bewilderment, 'Well, that shocked me. The instant I saw that face, I cried out and fell over. I've never seen such a smirk in my life. It looked terribly lecherous.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k182; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
We received a passionate sighting from K, a birdwatching enthusiast, which we would like to share.
K was apparently watching the giant creature through a telescope when a glance at the Fortune Center Building revealed two figures.

Curious, K zoomed in further and, astonishingly, witnessed the two people kissing.
K commented,
'Well, how disgraceful! I wondered what they were doing, and there were two young people kissing. They ought to consider the time and place. Disgraceful, really.'
Their face was bright red.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k184; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
We received a suspicious sighting from K, a birdwatching enthusiast, which we would like to share.
K was apparently watching the giant creature through a telescope when a glance at the Fortune Center Building revealed two figures.

Curious, K zoomed in and saw the people handing over 'something white.'
K said suspiciously, 'I couldn't see exactly what it was, but they were handing over something white. I think it had a slight sheen. What on earth were they exchanging in a situation like that? It must have been some shady deal.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k186; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
We received a mysterious sighting from K, a birdwatching enthusiast, which we would like to share.
K was apparently watching the giant creature through a telescope when a glance at the Fortune Center Building revealed two figures.

Curious, K zoomed in and saw a woman giving the other person a large number of eggs.
K gazed into the distance and said, 'That might have been an Egg Person. My grandfather told me about them back in the countryside. Apparently, they love eggs to a frightening degree, eat nothing else, and can live two hundred years on eggs alone. Their obsession is extraordinary. If they spot you carrying eggs, they'll follow you relentlessly, even into your home, until you hand over every one. Come to think of it, we even had an Egg Person-proof fence at home. Ha-ha.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k188; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
K, the birdwatching enthusiast who contacted us earlier, has provided another sighting concerning the 'Egg Person.'
K apparently continued watching the Egg Person's movements afterward.

After receiving the large quantity of eggs, the Egg Person reportedly kept demanding more from the woman.
She apparently still had some and reluctantly handed over the remainder.

K said solemnly, 'There's no doubt. That was an Egg Person. That persistence is unique to them. They're harmless if you give them eggs, but there's no telling what might happen if you carelessly eat one in front of them. If you meet an Egg Person, I strongly recommend handing over your eggs quietly. I don't want what happened to my grandfather to happen again.'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k190; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Almost every year, people say of the young, 'Young people these days lose their tempers easily.'
'These days' makes it sound as though they did not in the past. But is that really true?
Regardless of the era, isn't youth itself an age when tempers flare easily?

Why is that age so prone to anger in the first place?
Perhaps young people have nowhere to direct their abundant energy, and it emerges in the form of 'losing their temper.'
In other words, aren't people who 'snap easily' people with no outlet for their energy?
Viewed this way, perhaps there are not more angry people, but fewer opportunities to find an outlet.

If so, this seems less a problem with young people than with society as a whole.
Perhaps modern life is gradually offering fewer things into which young people can pour their feelings.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k198; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Several figures were reportedly seen among the remains of the Fortune Center Building after it collapsed in the giant weapon's rampage.
After a while, they apparently entered a door left standing in the wreckage.
Someone familiar with the building's structure commented, 'The remaining section contains stairs leading to the first floor. Judging by its condition, they could have escaped through that door.' Their safety, however, has not yet been confirmed.

Police have also just reached the scene, and rescue work appears to have begun.
I hope everyone is rescued as soon as possible.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k200; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The threats associated with the enormous black creature include its massive body walking around and the heat ray from its mouth. But I would like to emphasize that its occasional roars and cries are also a considerable threat.

The office in the building where I work suffered an extraordinary disaster after one such cry.
Every window shattered at once, and the sheer shock briefly knocked me unconscious.
I somehow regained consciousness, only to be stunned by how the office had changed.
Desks and lockers had been slammed to the ground, documents and everything else were in chaos, and large cracks ran through the ceiling and walls.
The ceiling looked ready to collapse. Realizing it was dangerous to stay, I barely escaped the office with my life.

I suspect every building in the area suffered similar damage.
Its body and heat ray may seem like the most frightening things, but even its cries endanger us.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k202; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Before dawn today, W&P Consulting's offices suffered devastating damage from a giant shadow.
W&P Consulting holds a major global share in weapons intelligence and brokerage. Its destruction is likely to send ripples around the world.
Some investors are already making moves, and today's stock market is expected to be turbulent.

W&P Consulting is expected to issue some kind of announcement today. Its contents are likely to draw considerable attention.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k204; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Before dawn today, Miyato Prefectural Police received a report that ten million yen kept in W&P Consulting's offices, devastated by a giant shadow, had been stolen.
According to the person connected with W&P who discovered it, every bundle of banknotes that should have been inside a safe left at the collapsed site was gone.
The safe showed no sign of being forced open by the impact, and no bundles of banknotes lay scattered nearby, making it highly likely that someone unlocked it and took the contents.
Miyato Prefectural Police are investigating while carefully establishing the facts.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k210; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The story of 'slipping on a banana peel' has been passed down as a joke since long ago.
One day, however, our editorial department noticed a crucial fact about it.
Yes: not one of us had ever slipped on a banana peel.

Strange. Something was strange. We shuddered.
Perhaps they were not slippery at all, and we had merely been made to believe they were.
Could a government conspiracy, for instance, be manipulating the information?

With so little information, we immediately formed a team and decided to investigate the following thoroughly:
'Can a person really slip on a banana peel?'

We calmly placed a banana on the floor and stepped on it.
We repeated roughly one hundred thousand variations of the experiment, changing the angle of the step, the shoes, the banana variety, our mood that day, and more. After three weeks of exhaustive testing, the team finally reached its conclusion: 'Banana peels really are slippery.'

Rest assured.
Banana peels were slippery after all.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k212; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The latest giant-shadow anomaly before dawn today also caused immense damage in Yotsuba Ward.
The damage extends throughout the ward, and with the disaster striking late at night, many people are missing.

The wide area affected has left police and firefighters short of personnel. Assistance is reportedly being requested from outside their usual districts.
Across Yotsuba Ward, people believed to be family members have collapsed in tears atop the rubble or tried to remove debris without waiting for rescuers. Heartbroken cries from victims echo everywhere.

Many who failed to escape remain beneath collapsed homes and buildings. Swift rescue operations are needed.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k214; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
S, a resident of Yotsuba Ward, had collapsed in terror directly beneath the building at the moment the giant weapon struck it.
Then both a miracle and a misfortune befell S.

After the weapon collided with the Fortune Center Building, rubble, desks, lockers, and other objects rained down toward S.
Astonishingly, every single one missed, leaving S without a scratch.
It can only be called a miracle.

S later somehow reached the station, but everyone who looked at their face reacted with shock.
Wondering why, S hurried to check a mirror and found their face completely black.
Apparently, ink or something similar had been spilled all over S.
Alongside the miracle had come this small misfortune.

S remained positive: 'Since then, little bits of bad luck keep happening. I even slipped on a banana just now. It's like my misfortune is being paid in installments. But none of it matters unless you're alive, right?'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k216; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Have you heard the rumor about the Fortune Center Building's 'nonexistent floor'?
The Fortune Center Building was a thirty-six-story high-rise, but a rumor, particularly among high school students, claimed a floor 10.5 existed between the tenth and eleventh floors.
Our investigative team questioned building staff and others to discover the truth but ultimately could not confirm it.

However, after the building's complete destruction, the team carefully counted its floors and confirmed that there were thirty-seven. Astonishingly, the rumored floor apparently really existed.
Everyone connected with the building is puzzled by this result. Who built that floor, and for what purpose, remains a mystery.

It is deeply regrettable that this mystery has been buried beneath the rubble.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k220; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Taicho Inc.'s 'Water from the Foot of Mt. Hakusan Dispenser' service.
It has become a familiar sight, but did you know how much hardship preceded its success?

At first, apparently every employee carried barrels up the foot of Mt. Hakusan, collected water, and brought them down again, repeating this daily.
The work was so punishing that many collapsed from overwork. Six months after launch, the service's survival was reportedly in doubt.

Nevertheless, the president was determined to provide water from the foot of Mt. Hakusan. Somehow persuading management and investors, the company adopted its present system of channeling the water to a factory.
Some customers, however, apparently insist, 'You can't call that water from the foot of Mt. Hakusan.' As a premium service, the old method of collecting it in barrels therefore remains.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k224; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Large numbers of banknotes were seen flying through the air around the Fortune Center Building, which was completely destroyed before dawn today.
Nearby residents who had come to look rushed joyfully to grab them, while men apparently connected with the building shouted angrily to stop them, creating utter pandemonium.
Something resembling a safe lay open atop the rubble, apparently scattering the banknotes.

Police subsequently arrived and ended the disturbance after several dozen minutes.
All banknotes collected by residents were apparently confiscated. Some residents and people connected with the building were also temporarily detained.
The recovered notes are now being counted to check for shortages, though some losses seem unavoidable.

Apparently, the safe showed no sign of being forced open by the impact, leading to suspicions that someone responsible had forgotten to lock it.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k226; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Images of the Fortune Center Building's remains uploaded to social media have attracted comments from Japan and abroad:
'Amazing that it could be left standing like that!'
'Good heavens, what kind of construction technology does this country have?'
'It looks dangerous, but I kind of want to climb it.'

It is no exaggeration to call the building completely destroyed, yet its former ends have miraculously remained standing.
Someone apparently connected with the building posted, 'It is dangerous and will be removed soon.' Responses included, 'What a waste to remove it,' and, 'It should be preserved as a symbol of what happened.'
Nevertheless, leaving it would naturally risk collapse, so those responsible likely have no choice but to remove it.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0134.json:p0/k228; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The giant-shadow incident in Yotsuba Ward sparked fires throughout the ward.
Some are still burning fiercely, with the use of flammable construction materials identified as a cause.
In the worst-hit area, building debris itself is burning. Apparently, the material used there became more flammable as it aged.
It reportedly did not violate the law, but legislation concerning the material may now change.

Ironically, while giant shadows are causing immense damage everywhere, they have also exposed problems that had previously gone unremarked.

entries.en:
What appears to be a new computer virus has suddenly begun spreading widely.
When a computer is infected, apparently all its files are replaced by pictures of nuts.
Its source remains unknown, but it is exploiting computer vulnerabilities skillfully and spreading explosively.
At present, the only concrete countermeasure is essentially 'do not connect to the internet.' A swift response from those responsible is needed.
Worldwide damage is expected to reach hundreds of billions of yen, and cybercrime police in various countries have apparently begun taking action.
